33 Execution SECONDAMENDEDANDRESTATED ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT EASEMENT AGREEMENT is made as of this I 8th day of November, 2014 (this "Agreement"), between LE I APARTMENTS LLC., a New York limited liability company, having an address c/o Starrett Corp.70 East 55th Street, 7th Floor,NewYork,NewYork 10022 (such entity, together with its successors and assigns, collectively, “Seller") and LE1SUB LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address c/o Starrett Corp. 70 East 55th Street, collectively,"Developer"). A. Seller is the owner of certain land knownby the street address 257SouthStreet, New York, New York, also known as Tax Lot 1 in Block 246 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon (said land being herein referred to as "Seller's Land", and said improvements, together with any future replacements thereof, being herein referred to as “"Seller's Existing Building"; Seller's Land and Seller's Existing Building being herein referred to as “Seller's Property"). B. Developer is the owner of certain land adjacent to Seller's Land, known as Tax Lot 5 in Block 246 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein referred to as “Developer's Land"; each of Developer's Land and Seller's Land shall sometimes be referred to herein, individually, as a“Parcel"). C.s Seller, as successor in interest to Land's End Associates, L.P., and Developer are parties to that certain Zoning Lot Development Agreement dated as of September 15, 2011 (the "Original ZLDA"), recorded in the New York County Office of the Register of The City of New York (the “City Register") on November 28, 2011, CRFN 2011000411832, as amended andrestated by thatcertain October 24,2014Amended andRestated ZoningLotDevelopment and Easement Agreement (the “ZLDA Amendment") by and between Seller and Developer, which was not recorded (the Original ZLDA, as amended and restated by the ZLDA Amendment,the"ZLDA"). D.Pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the "Declaration") dated as of September 15, 2011 and recorded in the City Register on November 28, 2011, CRFN 2011000411831, Developer's Property and Seller's Property, being contiguous for a minimum of ten (1o) linear feet and'within a single block,were confirmed and declared a single “zoning lot" (such single zoning lot being herein referred to as the “Combined Zoning Lot"), as such term is defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York, effective December 15, 1961 (as amended to date, the “Zoning Resolution"). E.！ Developer may (but in no event shall be obligated to) construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land and/or other adjacent land (said new building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements NY75437025

Execution thereof or enlargements or additions thereto,whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, whether upon Developer's Land and/or other adjacent land (collectively, the “Development Site"), being herein referred to as “Developer's Proposed Building"; Property"). F. Developer and Seller are parties to that certain Agreement dated as of May 12, 2014 (the “Cooperation Agreement"), which is intended to be recorded against the Seller's Land and Developer's Land promptly after the date hereof. G. The parties hereto desire to amend and restate the ZLDA in its entirety.
